content_sections.heading: About ICMR NINE
content_sections.text: The ICMR National Institute of NCD Epidemiology (NINE) was previously called ICMR NCDIR. It is an ICMR research institute at Nirmal Bhawan-ICMR Complex, Poojanahalli Road, Kannamangala Post, Bengaluru – 562 110, Karnataka. The duties of both posts are built around NINE research outputs and NCRP reports. The notice says that more about the institute's mission, functions and research focus is on its website, https://icmrnine.org/.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 Young Professional-II posts, one in each area. Both posts have the same pay and the same age limit. The Director, ICMR NINE, reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts, cancel the recruitment or re-advertise the posts without giving a reason. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience must be in the relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation recognised by the relevant authority. Experience counts from the date the minimum educational qualification was completed. Candidates with more than one eligible qualification must choose only one for the selection process. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organisation are not eligible. The age limit for both posts is a maximum of 35 years, counted as on the date of interview (13 November 2026). Relaxation of the upper age limit is allowed as per rules. Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly well suited for this role: MPH with specialization in Epidemiology or Health Policy Master's in Public Policy (MPP) with health focus Health Economics or Health Systems Research training Candidates with experience working on NCD epidemiology, cancer control, or public health surveillance programmes Candidates with experience in conducting systematic review and meta-analysis Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in public health research, policy analysis or evidence synthesis Experience working with government health programmes, national institutes, or policy think tanks Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly suited: Science Communication / Health Communication specialists Public Health graduates with strong communication skills Candidates with experience translating scientific research into public communication Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in science communication, health communication, or digital media Experience working with research institutes, universities, or public health organizations Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: YP II – Public Policy & Evidence Translation
rows.essential_qualification: Masters/Postgraduate with at least 55 % of marks in Public Health (MPH), Health Policy, Epidemiology, Health Systems, Health Economics, or Public Policy from a recognized institution with Three-year post qualification experience in relevant field.

Master's degree with at least 55% marks in Science Communication, Public Health Communication, Mass Communication, Journalism, Digital Media, or Public Health with Three year of post qualification experience in the related field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay a consolidated salary of Rs.42,000/- per month (All inclusive). Income tax and any other tax due under the prevailing rules is deducted at source before the monthly emoluments are paid. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. The initial term is one year. An extension, if any, will be considered case by case, depending on job requirements, satisfactory performance and the Institute's need for the services. The selected candidate will not be treated as an "employee" or "official" of ICMR for any purpose. He or she will have no claim to an extension beyond the contract, to regularisation of service in ICMR or any of its Institutes/Centres or the Govt. of India, or to a regular appointment in the Council. The contract can be ended at any time without prior notice and without a reason. In the normal course, however, either side may end it by giving at least one month's notice at any time, without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NINE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct missing data analysis, support documentation and reporting and adapt to evolving project needs. Develop policy briefs, evidence summaries, and policy notes based on NINE/NCRP research outputs. Translate epidemiological and surveillance findings into policy-relevant communication for ministries, national health programmes, and international agencies. Conduct rapid evidence synthesis and literature reviews related to cancer epidemiology, environmental risk factors, and NCD prevention strategies. Assist in preparation of technical reports, white papers, and national policy background documents. Support preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic communication documents for senior policymakers and program managers. Contribute to evidence-based policy recommendations related to cancer surveillance, environmental determinants of cancer, and NCD control strategies. Key skill sets required: Policy and Research Skills: ability to translate epidemiological research into policy-relevant insights; strong capability in rapid literature review and evidence synthesis; experience drafting policy briefs, background notes, or policy summaries. Analytical Skills: understanding of public health data interpretation; familiarity with NCD epidemiology, cancer surveillance, and health system issues. Communication Skills: strong scientific writing and policy communication; ability to prepare concise policy summaries for decision makers. Technical Skills: familiarity with reference management tools (EndNote, Zotero); basic knowledge of data interpretation from epidemiological datasets. Develop communication products based on NINE research publications and NCRP reports. Prepare research highlights, summaries, and simplified explanations of scientific findings. Create infographics, visual abstracts, and communication materials for reports and publications. Support dissemination of NINE outputs through website, newsletters, digital platforms, and social media channels. Develop multimedia communication content including short videos, explainer graphics, and social media posts. Assist in organizing webinars, outreach events, and research dissemination activities. Key skill sets required: Scientific Communication Skills: ability to convert technical research findings into clear and engaging communication; experience preparing visual abstracts, summaries, and knowledge translation products. Digital Communication Skills: experience managing social media communication for research institutions; familiarity with digital dissemination strategies for scientific content. Creative and Technical Skills: ability to design infographics and visual communication materials; experience with tools such as Canva, Adobe Illustrator, PowerPoint design, or similar platforms. Editorial Skills: strong writing and editing skills for scientific summaries and public communication; ability to maintain accuracy while simplifying complex research findings.

content_sections.text: Download the application form from the ICMR website (www.icmr.gov.in) or the ICMR NINE website (https://icmrnine.org/). Fill in the application in the prescribed ICMR application format and affix a recent passport photograph. Attach self-attested copies of your education and experience documents, arranged in chronological order. Email the application to ICMR NINE, Bengaluru, at [email protected] on or before 5:00 PM on 12 November 2026. To attend the interview online, get prior permission by email. To attend in person, report at ICMR NINE, Bengaluru, at 09:30 AM on 13 November 2026 and hand in the original, duly filled application in the prescribed format. Documents named in the notice: Duly filled application in the ICMR application format, with a recent passport photograph affixed Self-attested copies of documents related to education Self-attested copies of experience documents The original application, to be handed in at the walk-in interview Only applicants who have sent the documents supporting their educational qualifications and work experience will be considered for the online interview. Incomplete applications, and applications without a photograph or copies of the relevant certificates, will not be entertained. An original application handed in at the walk-in interview will not be considered unless the application was also sent by email. Applications received by email after the due date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted on the basis of the prescribed qualifications, experience and age. The engagement will be made on the basis of the results of the Examination/Written Test/interview/personal discussion. Meeting the essential qualification or experience does not by itself guarantee selection. The interview is on 13 November 2026, with reporting at 09:30 AM. The mode is Online/Walk-in-Interview, and the place of interview is ICMR NINE, Bengaluru. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the examination, test or interview. Incorrect or false information given during the interview or personal discussion will disqualify the candidate at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICMR-NINE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 01 for Young Professional-II (Public Policy & Evidence Translation) and 01 for Young Professional-II (Scientific Communication & Media).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR-NINE Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach [email protected] on or before 5:00 PM on 12 November 2026. Applications received after that time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the ICMR-NINE interview?
faq.answer: The online/walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026 at ICMR-NINE, Bengaluru. Reporting time is 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ICMR-NINE Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: Each post needs a master's or postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in a field named for that post, plus three years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field. For Public Policy & Evidence Translation, the fields are Public Health (MPH), Health Policy, Epidemiology, Health Systems, Health Economics or Public Policy. For Scientific Communication & Media, they are Science Communication, Public Health Communication, Mass Communication, Journalism, Digital Media or Public Health.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ICMR-NINE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, counted as on the date of interview. Relaxation of the upper age limit is allowed as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an ICMR-NINE Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs.42,000/- per month (All inclusive). Income tax and other applicable taxes are deducted at source.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for ICMR-NINE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted on the basis of qualifications, experience and age. The engagement is then decided on the results of the Examination/Written Test/interview/personal discussion.

faq.question: Q8. Can I attend the ICMR-NINE interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. The interview mode is Online/Walk-in, but candidates who want to attend online must get prior permission by email. Only applicants who have emailed documents supporting their qualifications and experience will be considered for the online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICMR-NINE Young Professional-II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary, contractual engagement for one year, and an extension may be considered case by case. The selected candidate has no claim to regularisation or to a regular appointment in the Council.

faq.question: Q10. Can government employees apply for ICMR-NINE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organisation are not eligible.
